artifacts.name: agent-guidelines
artifacts.description: Agent working agreements: what co-status owns (dead-man's timers, alerts through notifier's /dispatch, never delivered here), module map, infrastructure and ports, releases and deploy.sh, credentials, the frozen check-in contract, conventions.

artifacts.name: design-specs
artifacts.description: Designs of record: the MVP (decisions D1-D15, the check-in contract, notifier as the only delivery path), releases and deploy (R1-R13), alert faults (#28).

artifacts.name: monitors-reference
artifacts.description: The dead-man's timer: monitor model, API, what gets sent and when, the owed alert, redelivery, who watches the sweep.

artifacts.name: deployment
artifacts.description: Releases under /srv/status, scripts/deploy.sh, the CI gate, rollback, drift, units and host configs, the schema check, health checks, Node.js from NodeSource.

artifacts.name: runbook
artifacts.description: First-time setup, routine ops, reading undelivered alerts and notices, healthchecks.io watching, the cutover of a monitor from notifier.

artifacts.name: socraticode-doc
artifacts.description: Semantic search reference: tool table, the prefetch hook, per-tool notes, graph health and index scope, plus this repo's pin, link stub, one-host rule and memory caps.

artifacts.name: implementation-plans
artifacts.description: Dated implementation plans, one per issue. History: a later plan or the code supersedes an earlier one.

artifacts.name: migrations
artifacts.description: Alembic migrations, expand-only: the schema of tenants, api keys, monitors and monitor_events, and each column's history.

artifacts.name: notifier-checkin-contract
artifacts.description: notifier's check-in contract at notifier@2c02dbf, frozen here (D6): request and response of POST /api/v1/monitors/{id}/checkin.

artifacts.name: deploy-units
artifacts.description: What this VM runs: the API, sweep and drift units (live and dev), memory reservations and OOM policy, earlyoom, needrestart, the NodeSource apt files.

artifacts.name: ci-workflow
artifacts.description: GitHub Actions: lint, test (CPython 3.12, uv sync --locked, Postgres 16), migrations; the jobs deploy.sh's CI gate requires.

artifacts.description: Dependency and tool contract: Python >=3.12, bounded specifiers, notifier-client, ruff rules, pytest and coverage config.
